0.name: Step pulse time
0.description:
Step pulse length in microseconds.
Minimum depends on the processor and is typically in the range of 1 - 2.5.

The length has to be reduced from the default value of 5 when max. step rate exceed approximately 140 kHz.

1.name: Step idle delay
1.description: Sets a short hold delay when stopping to let dynamics settle before disabling steppers. Value 255 keeps motors enabled.

4.name: Invert stepper enable output(s)
4.description:
Inverts the stepper driver enable signals. Most drivers uses active low enable requiring inversion.

NOTE: If the stepper drivers shares the same enable signal only X is used.

5.name: Invert limit inputs
5.description: Inverts the axis limit input signals.

9.name: PWM spindle options
9.format: Enable,RPM controls spindle enable signal,Disable laser mode capability,Enable ramping
9.description:
Enable controls PWM output availability.
When `RPM controls spindle enable signal` is checked and M3 or M4 is active S0 switches it off and S > 0 switches it on.
When 'Ramping enable' is checked spin up and spin down time is calculated from $394 and $539 respectively.

10.name: Status report options
10.format: Position in machine coordinate,Buffer state,Line numbers,Feed & speed,Pin state,Work coordinate offset,Overrides,Probe coordinates,Buffer sync on WCO change,Parser state,Alarm substatus,Run substatus,Enable when homing,Distance-to-go
10.description:
Specifies optional data included in status reports and if report is sent when homing.
If Run substatus is enabled it may be used for simple probe protection.

NOTE: Parser state will be sent separately after the status report and only on changes.

11.name: Junction deviation
11.description: Sets how fast grblHAL travels through consecutive motions. Lower value slows it down.

12.name: Arc tolerance
12.description: Sets the G2 and G3 arc tracing accuracy based on radial error. Beware: A very small value may effect performance.

13.name: Report in inches
13.description: Enables inch units when returning any position and rate value that is not a settings value.

14.name: Invert control inputs
14.description:
Inverts the control signals (active low).
NOTE: Block delete, Optional stop, EStop and Probe connected are optional signals, availability is driver dependent.

15.name: Invert coolant outputs
15.description: Inverts the coolant and mist signals (active low).

16.name: Invert spindle signals
16.description:
Inverts the spindle on, counterclockwise and PWM signals (active low).

NOTE: A hard reset of the controller is required after changing this setting.

17.name: Pullup disable control inputs
17.description:
Disable the control signals pullup resistors. Potentially enables pulldown resistor if available.
NOTE: Block delete, Optional stop and EStop are optional signals, availability is driver dependent.

18.name: Pullup disable limit inputs
18.description: Disable the limit signals pullup resistors. Potentially enables pulldown resistors if available.

19.name: Pullup disable probe inputs
19.description: Disable the probe signal pullup resistor(s). Potentially enables pulldown resistor(s) if available.

20.name: Soft limits enable
20.description: Enables soft limits checks within machine travel and sets alarm when exceeded. Requires homing.

21.name: Hard limits enable
21.description: When enabled immediately halts motion and throws an alarm when a limit switch is triggered. In strict mode only homing is possible when a switch is engaged.

22.name: Homing cycle
22.format: Enable,Enable single axis commands,Homing on startup required,Set machine origin to 0,Two switches shares one input,Allow manual,Override locks,N/A,N/A,Per axis feedrates,Run startup scripts only on homing completed
22.description:
Enables homing cycle. Requires limit switches on axes to be automatically homed.

When `Enable single axis commands` is checked, single axis homing can be performed by $H<axis letter> commands.

When `Allow manual` is checked, axes not homed automatically may be homed manually by $H or $H<axis letter> commands.

`Override locks` is for allowing a soft reset to disable `Homing on startup required`.

23.name: Homing direction invert
23.description: Homing searches for a switch in the positive direction. Set axis bit to search in negative direction.

24.name: Homing locate feed rate
24.description: Feed rate to slowly engage limit switch to determine its location accurately.

25.name: Homing search seek rate
25.description: Seek rate to quickly find the limit switch before the slower locating phase.

26.name: Homing switch debounce delay
26.description: Sets a short delay between phases of homing cycle to let a switch debounce.

27.name: Homing switch pull-off distance
27.description: Retract distance after triggering switch to disengage it. Homing will fail if switch isn't cleared.

28.name: G73 Retract distance
28.description: G73 retract distance (for chip breaking drilling).

29.name: Pulse delay
29.description:
Step pulse delay.

When set > 0 and less than 2 the value is rounded up to 2 microseconds.

30.name: Maximum spindle speed
30.description: Maximum spindle speed, can be overridden by spindle plugins.

31.name: Minimum spindle speed
31.description:
Minimum spindle speed, can be overridden by spindle plugins.

When set > 0 $35 (PWM min value) may have to be set to get the configured RPM.

32.name: Mode of operation
32.description:
Laser mode: consecutive G1/2/3 commands will not halt when spindle speed is changed.
Lathe mode: allows use of G7, G8, G96 and G97.

37.name: Steppers to keep enabled

39.name: Enable legacy RT commands
39.description: Enables "normal" processing of ?, ! and ~ characters when part of $-setting or comment. If disabled then they are added to the input string instead.

40.name: Limit jog commands
40.description: Limit jog commands to machine workspace for homed axes.

41.name: Parking cycle
41.format: Enable,Deactivate upon init,Enable parking override control
41.description: Enables parking cycle, requires parking axis homed.

42.name: Parking axis
42.description: Define which axis that performs the parking motion.

43.name: Homing passes
43.description: Number of homing passes. Minimum 1, maximum 128.

44.name: Axes homing, first phase
44.description: Axes to home in first phase.

46.name: Axes homing, third phase
46.description: Axes to home in third phase.

47.description: Axes to home in fourth phase.

58.name: Parking target

341.name: Tool change mode
341.format: Normal,Manual touch off,Manual touch off @ G59.3,Automatic touch off @ G59.3,Ignore M6
341.description:
Normal: allows jogging for manual touch off. Set new position manually.

Manual touch off: rapids to tool change position, use jogging or $TPW for touch off.

Manual touch off @ G59.3: rapids to tool change position, after change to G59.3 position for manual touch off. Use jogging or $TPW for touch off.

Automatic touch off @ G59.3: rapids to tool change position, after change to G59.3 position for automatic touch off.

Depending on settings the tool (controlled point) will be moved back to the to original position after touch off. "tool change position" is either tool axis home, G59.3 or G30 position depending on settings.

342.name: Tool change probing distance
342.description: Maximum probing distance for automatic or $TPW touch off.

343.name: Tool change locate feed rate
343.description: Feed rate to slowly engage tool change sensor to determine the tool offset accurately.

344.name: Tool change search seek rate
344.description: Seek rate to quickly find the tool change sensor before the slower locating phase.

345.name: Tool change probe pull-off rate
345.description: Pull-off rate for the retract move before the slower locating phase.

346.name: Tool change options
346.format: Restore position after M6,Change tool at G30,Fast probe pull off
346.description:
Restore position after M6: when set the spindle is moved so that the controlled point (tool tip) is the same as before the M6 command,if not the spindle is only moved to the Z home position.

Change tool at G30: when set rapids to the G30 position via tool axis home. Requires axes to be homed.

Fast probe pulloff: use G38.4 style probing for faster touch off.

376.name: Rotary axes

384.name: Disable G92 persistence

394.description:

398.name: Planner buffer blocks
398.description:

481.name: Autoreport interval

484.name: Unlock required after E-Stop

486.name: Lock coordinate systems

Perform fast move to angle stored in G28 position.

 G91G28<axisletter>0

`Fix feedrate` changes feedrate to inverse time mode for combined angular and linear moves.
